classification.hazard_class: Specific target organ toxicity - single exposure
classification.text: Specific target organ toxicity - single exposure : Category 3 (Respiratory system)

classification.hazard_class: Specific target organ toxicity - repeated exposure (Inhalation)
classification.text: Specific target organ toxicity - repeated exposure (Inhalation) : Category 2

hazard_statements.statement: May cause an allergic skin reaction.
hazard_statements.text: H317 May cause an allergic skin reaction.

hazard_statements.statement: May cause allergy or asthma symptoms or breathing difficulties if inhaled.
hazard_statements.text: H334 May cause allergy or asthma symptoms or breathing difficulties if inhaled.

hazard_statements.statement: May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure if inhaled.
hazard_statements.text: H373 May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure if inhaled.

precautionary_statements.statement: Obtain special instructions before use.
precautionary_statements.text: P201 Obtain special instructions before use.

precautionary_statements.statement: Do not handle until all safety precautions have been read and understood.
precautionary_statements.text: P202 Do not handle until all safety precautions have been read and understood.

precautionary_statements.statement: Do not breathe mist or vapours.
precautionary_statements.text: P260 Do not breathe mist or vapours.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wash skin thoroughly after handling.
precautionary_statements.text: P264 Wash skin thoroughly after handling.

precautionary_statements.statement: Use only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area.
precautionary_statements.text: P271 Use only outdoors or in a well-ventilated area.

precautionary_statements.statement: Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
precautionary_statements.text: P272 Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear protective gloves/ protective clothing/ eye protection/ face protection/ hearing protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P280 Wear protective gloves/ protective clothing/ eye protection/ face protection/ hearing protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: Wear respiratory protection.
precautionary_statements.text: P284 Wear respiratory protection.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor if you feel unwell.
precautionary_statements.text: P304 + P340 + P312 IF INHALED: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor if you feel unwell.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
precautionary_statements.text: P305 + P351 + P338 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. Remove contact lenses, if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF exposed or concerned: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P308 + P313 IF exposed or concerned: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P333 + P313 If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/ attention.
precautionary_statements.text: P337 + P313 If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.statement: If experiencing respiratory symptoms: Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.
precautionary_statements.text: P342 + P311 If experiencing respiratory symptoms: Call a POISON CENTER/ doctor.

precautionary_statements.statement: Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.
precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.statement: Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed.
precautionary_statements.text: P403 + P233 Store in a well-ventilated place. Keep container tightly closed.

precautionary_statements.statement: Store locked up.
precautionary_statements.text: P405 Store locked up.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid formation of aerosol. Do not breathe vapours or spray mist. Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Provide sufficient air exchange and/or exhaust in work rooms. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
